# DirtyWeylSemimetal

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A Weyl semimetal with disorder that can alter its topological phase diagram, potentially inducing transitions between topological and trivial phases. Relevant to iNEST systems where material disorder or hardware imperfections may affect neuromorphic signal routing and phase-based computation.
